review_candidates.title: Senior Virtual Desktop Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Provide Level 3 operational support for Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Dev Box, Windows 365, and Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktops environments. • Troubleshoot complex VDI-related issues, including connectivity, authentication, performance, profiles, printing, and application delivery, working closely with Service Desk and Level 2 Operational Support teams. • Deploy and maintain golden images, application packages, OS updates, and security patches while minimizing use
eligibility_evidence: A multinational organization is seeking an experienced Senior Virtual Desktop Engineer to provide Level 3 support and development for enterprise virtual workplace platforms, including Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Microsoft Dev Box, Windows 365, and Citrix environments.
We bring together more than 30,000 people from over 70 nationalities, coming from five continents.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: • 7 years of experience in Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, End User Computing, or Workplace Platform Engineering. • Strong expertise in Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, Microsoft Dev Box, and Citrix environments. • Strong expertise with Nerdio Manager for Enterprise, including host pool automation, autoscaling, image management, patching, and Azure cost optimization. • Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting, Azure Automation, and infrastructure automation for VDI administration.
